usage: Existing image references passed directly to the connected OpenAI image tool. Images are modeling references, not meshes.
regeneration: Resolve each referenced_image_paths entry against repository root; call image_gen.imagegen once per item with the exact prompt and transparent_background:false. Generation is nondeterministic; no fixed seed or version is exposed.

sheets.prompt: Use the supplied images directly as visual source material and recompose them into a NEW landscape 16:9 professional production sheet for ARCANA GUARDIANS. Preserve recognisable identity, hair, garments, weapon construction, palette and large shapes of the existing characters. Refine blocky prototype geometry into polished, readable stylized 3D-sculpt concept art, with chunky clean bevels, substantial weight, crafted material separation and restrained detail. This is an illustrated reference for later actual Blender work, not a finished model or screenshot. No franchise copying, no game HUD, no dense lore or statistics. The final reference image of an otter is a presentation/material-quality reference ONLY: do not turn any of the heroes into an otter. Neutral warm gray studio background, consistent soft lighting and foot contact shadows, clean grid, generous full-body margins. Exactly three character columns, not six unrelated designs. Short English name labels only. Source images 1,2,3 are the exact character identity anchors; image4 supplies the established woodland art direction. LEFT COLUMN IAN: the existing ivory-haired human mage, deep midnight blue pointed brimmed hat with gold edge and tiny emblem, blue long coat/cape, cream chest tunic, large brass buckle and substantial boots. Keep the tall wooden staff and pale CYAN faceted crystal from the prototype; one small secondary fire-casting study may show a warm ember without recoloring his blue costume or staff. MIDDLE COLUMN RIEL: existing slim blond elf archer, long pointed ears, forest-green pointed hood/cap, green cloak and split tunic, brass shoulder clasps, brown leather belt, gloves and boots, curved natural wood bow with intact string and quiver. Preserve the graceful slim silhouette, do not make the bow into a staff. RIGHT COLUMN BRON: existing very short broad heavy dwarf engineer, copper-orange braided beard, dark teal segmented armor and cape, squat helmet with cyan/teal diamond inset, large beveled rectangular STONE AND METAL HAMMER with oak handle and cyan central mark, small polygonal wrist shield on opposite arm, huge broad planted boots. Keep helmet, wrist shield and hammer from the prototype. Do not replace him with the bareheaded taller red barbarian. LAYOUT: top 55 percent has THREE large fully visible near-front 3/4 idle stances, side by side, ONE PER CHARACTER, on a shared ground line with honest relative heights (Bron shorter and wider, Riel tallest/slimmest, Ian middle). Middle 30 percent has SIDE and BACK views of each SAME character at one consistent smaller scale, clear cloak attachment, quiver or tool placement, each weapon in consistent hand. Bottom 15 percent under each column has one compact combat keypose and isolated signature weapon, not a frame sequence: Ian staff cast planted feet, Riel bow fully drawn and arrow nocked, Bron low braced hammer wind-up with both feet planted. Keep face/hair and armor identical between views. Use title 'ARCANA — CORE GUARDIANS'.

Directly use the THREE provided images to derive a new landscape 16:9 environment and modular building production reference sheet for the EXISTING Arcana Guardians default woodland village theme. Image1 is the authoritative woodland concept: living broadleaf trees, warm amber lamps, oak gates, ivory stone arches, muted teal flags, layered green valleys and a clear sandy path. Image2 is the AUTHORITATIVE actual village citadel shape: compact ivory stone square gatehouse, two stout round towers with teal roofs, a main broad teal hip roof with gold edges, front stone arch, double oak doors, teal diamond banners. Preserve this specific massing and identity while refining materials, not a different castle. Image3 supplies the latest coherent tower kit and clean substantial materials; include its ballista, mortar and crystal tower at appropriate smaller scale. Create a polished stylized 3D environment concept with believable height differences and visible structural thickness, not a flat painted map or collage of incompatible themes. LAYOUT: upper 65 percent is one large three-quarter isometric playable starter-village DIORAMA, seen at about 35-degree elevation so cliffs, wall depth and roof volume are readable. Clearly stepped geography: a grassy lower approach, one broad continuous gently climbing dirt ramp to the raised citadel courtyard, a short stone bridge spanning a visible narrow stream on the left, a slightly raised village terrace behind/alongside the fortress with TWO modest timber-and-plaster teal-roof cottages and one oak/stone workshop with lit forge, a supply store, mature broadleaf tree groups kept near outer perimeter. Four distinct simple circular sandstone tower foundations beside the approach, two occupied by the referenced towers, and walkable open routes wide enough for squads; retain strong open ground for action and clear occluding boundaries. Paths connect physically to doors and bridge landings. No enormous tree boss, no heroes covering the map, no snowy or desert assets, no floating disconnected tiles, no toy plastic surface, no superfluous tents. Soil and rock sides visible under the upper terrace, grass sits over soil thickness, ramp meets plateau seamlessly. Do not overdecorate or cover traversable lanes with plants. Lower 35 percent on a warm neutral background is a neatly spaced modular asset strip with SIX isolated items from exactly that diorama: same compact gatehouse front 3/4; cottage front and small side view paired; oak/stone workshop; short straight stone wall and matching end post; stone bridge plus its short stair/landing piece; small lantern/signpost/crate group. Same model language and proportions as upper scene, grounded contact shadows. Tiny material swatches for sandstone, oak, muted teal roof, grass, earth. The reference is for future real geometry, so make joints, bridge underside, roof thickness, retaining-wall bases and ramp elevations understandable. Minimal English labels only; title 'ARCANA — VERDANT STARTER KIT'. No UI, no construction selection outlines, no numerical levels, no gameplay claims.
